Job Description Summary 
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. We empower our teams to turn ideas into world-changing realities, creating an environment where every voice is valued and every contribution helps build a healthier world. 
 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
   
 Perform installation, maintenance, and repair of all Xray systems across the Midlands, with flexibility to support wider UK requirements. 

 Diagnose and resolve complex system-level faults across multi-technology platforms. 

 Build strong relationships with healthcare professionals to ensure equipment uptime and customer satisfaction. 

 Provide remote diagnostics and support from a home office, dialling into systems to troubleshoot and resolve issues where possible. 

 Collaborate with engineering teams, service centres, and commercial functions to deliver exceptional service. 

 Manage tools, spare parts, and travel logistics efficiently. 

 Complete all required documentation accurately and within deadlines. 

 Travel approximately 35–40% of the time, with occasional overnight stays. 

 Attend international training courses as required. 

 Be flexible to support overtime, short-notice callouts, and weekend shifts Compulsory. (1 in every 4 weekends) 

   
 Required Qualifications & Experience 
   
 HNC (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 

 Field service experience (medical imaging experience advantageous but not essential – full training provided). 

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 

 Self-motivated, organised, and able to work independently. 

 Experience with remote connectivity tools and diagnostics. 

 Good IT skills, including familiarity with software installation, virtual machines, and troubleshooting. 

 Full UK driving licence. 

 Fluent in English. 

   
 Desirable Skills 
 Experience with additional medical imaging modalities. 

 Knowledge of DICOM and IT/network troubleshooting. 

 Familiarity with CRM systems. 

 Project management experience. 

   
 What We’re Looking For 
   
 We are looking for individuals who demonstrate both technical expertise and a mindset aligned with our core principles. Successful candidates will be passionate about serving patients, customers, and colleagues, while maintaining a strong focus on delivering the future of healthcare. They will embrace a Lean mindset, seek opportunities to improve processes, and demonstrate entrepreneurial thinking when solving challenges. 
 We value team members who collaborate effectively, support one another, and contribute to a positive working environment where we can win together and enjoy the journey. In addition, we are looking for people who bring flexibility, positive energy, and a general willingness to take on new challenges, adapt to changing priorities, and support the needs of our customers, colleagues, and business. A proactive attitude, strong work ethic, and enthusiasm for continuous learning and development are essential for success in this role. 
 Technical expertise and a commitment to excellence 

 A passion to serve patients, customers, and colleagues 

 Focus on delivering the future of healthcare 

 A Lean mindset with a drive for continuous improvement 

 Entrepreneurial thinking and a proactive approach to problem solving 

 Strong collaboration skills and a team-first attitude 

 Flexibility, positive energy, and a general willingness to support the wider team and business needs 

 Adaptability, enthusiasm, and a desire for continuous learning and development 

   
 Why Join GE HealthCare? 
   
 As a standalone company since 2023, GE HealthCare combines over 125 years of innovation with the agility of a modern organisation. We are committed to creating a world where healthcare has no limits—through advanced technology, data-driven insights, and a culture built on care, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 
 
 Additional Information 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No
